title: cli test: the parity file's "no call shape this scan cannot read" case takes ~1.7s unloaded and times out at 5s in the merge queue
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: ① a measured defect with a named location, found landing PR #30753 (#30633). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p2, because it ejects PRs from the merge queue. Dedupe: `validate-build-gate-parity timed out`, `call shape this scan cannot read`; the merge-queue triage bot found no aggregate issue (signature `test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`). **New.**

## What happens

`packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` › "the command sources use no call shape this scan cannot read" (≈:1149) runs the per-character `codeOnly` masker (≈:568, `src.split('')` plus a char loop) over every `PARITY_COMMANDS` source, then several regexes. Measured locally on an idle container, the case takes 1669 / 1857 ms on `origin/main` and 1735 ms on PR #30753's head `922bc3dd6`, so the PR does not change it. Under the merge queue's full suite, Test Core (4/8) hit the default 5000 ms vitest timeout twice for PR #30753: queue builds 42149417291 and 42150976034, triage comments 6675447980 and 6675646310. Both runs failed with `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms`, not an assertion. PR #30753 touches only `packages/lint`.

## Expected

The case finishes well inside its budget under load. Either mask each file once and cache it (the scan is pure), or replace `codeOnly` with the repo's shared masker (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` `blank` / `scanSource`, if it fits the test's import rules). Do not just raise the timeout. Keep every assertion as it is.

Reader: `domain:server` (or `domain:devx`, CI health), `packages/cli/test` only.
